journey.name: spark transfer status
journey.description:
Verifies the transfer status screen after a transfer to spending through Spark, against the Figma section "Funds In Transfer (spark)". Every in-progress frame shows "Transfer Funds" with the menu and no back button, three steps, the active step's label under them, and one bottom-pinned button. A fast (Instant) transfer moves through: "Processing Payment" (step 1, Spark has not seen the deposit), "Payment Successful" (step 1 done, step 2, Spark lists it), "Adding To Spending Balance" (steps 1 and 2 done, step 3), all under "FUNDS IN TRANSFER" with "This should take a few minutes.", and ends on "Transfer Successful": "FUNDS MOVED TO SPENDING", the check, and "Awesome!". A normal speed (Later) transfer shows the same frames with "This should take about 30 minutes.".
Whether Spark reprices the fast transfer or offers none is the provider's call, so the run can't stage the "FAST TRANSFER FEE CHANGED" frame (coins, "Wait" and "Approve", testTags "SettingUpWait" and "SettingUpPay") or "FAST TRANSFER UNAVAILABLE" (coins, "Using Normal Transfer Speed"); TransferStatusTest.kt and SettingUpScreenTest.kt cover them. Spark lists a deposit about a minute after its broadcast, so each step shows for a few seconds at least.
Precondition: as in spark-transfer-to-spending.xml, a dev build with Spark connected on its regtest, built with `ESPLORA_URL` on Spark's regtest chain through `scripts/spark-regtest-esplora.py`, and Savings funded on that chain with `scripts/spark-regtest-fund.py` (at least 20 000 sats, confirmed). Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings"), tap "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending"), tap "25%" (testTag "SpendingAmountQuarter") and tap "Continue" (testTag "SpendingAmountContinue")
Verify "Instant" (testTag "SpendingConfirmInstant") is selected and swipe to confirm

Verify the status screen (testTag "LightningSettingUp") shows "Transfer Funds", "FUNDS IN TRANSFER", "Please wait, your funds transfer is in progress. This should take a few minutes." (testTag "SettingUpText"), step 1 active with "Processing Payment", and "Continue Using Bitkit" (testTag "TransferSuccess-button")
Wait up to 3 minutes for "Payment Successful" with step 1 checked, then for "Adding To Spending Balance" with steps 1 and 2 checked; each keeps the same headline, text and button

Wait up to 3 minutes for "Transfer Successful" (testTag "TransferSuccess"): "FUNDS MOVED TO SPENDING", "Your funds have been transferred and your spending balance is ready to use.", the check (testTag "TransferSuccessCheck") and "Awesome!" (testTag "TransferSuccess-button")
Tap "Awesome!" and verify the wallet home screen shows the higher Spending balance
